name: Chat Thread
description: A warm, document-style AI chat: typeset replies with code and sources, ink user bubbles, a streaming last answer and a composer that really sends.

props.name: messages
props.description: User messages ({ role: "user", text }) and assistant messages ({ role: "assistant", blocks, sources }).

props.name: streamLast
props.description: Stream the final assistant message in on mount.

props.name: reply
props.description: Returns the blocks streamed back after a send. Blocks are paragraphs, lists or code with **bold** and `code` inline.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called with the text whenever the user sends.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Mono metadata line under the title.

props.name: assistantName
props.description: Assistant name; its first letter becomes the avatar mark.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the outer section.
